modmenu.descriptionTranslation.cakefixes: Small client-side fixes for vanilla and mod bugs that hurt on Monumenta. Each fix has its own switch. Fixes: freezes when the server removes a player from a team they are not on; AppleSkin's HUD making the game wait for the graphics driver every frame. Option (off by default): a shorter banner draw distance.
cakefixes.config.title: CakeFixes
cakefixes.fix.teamRemovalFix.tooltip: The server sometimes removes a player from a team they are not on. Vanilla then builds a crash report each time, which freezes the game for 100–500 ms (often every few seconds in dungeons). On: skip that removal instead.
cakefixes.fix.appleSkinBlendQueryFix.too: AppleSkin asks the graphics driver every frame whether blending is on, which makes the game wait for the driver (about 5% of frame time on NVIDIA). On: answer from Minecraft's own record instead. Nothing on screen changes. Does nothing without AppleSkin.
cakefixes.fix.bannerDrawDistance.tooltip: Banners are decoration but cost 3–4% of frame time in banner-heavy dungeons. Banners farther than this aren't drawn. Off: vanilla (up to 64 blocks). This changes what you see, so it's off by default.
